bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for workforce innovation and job placement programs for individuals in recovery.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WORKFORCE INNOVATION AND JOB PLACEMENT PROGRAMS FOR INDIVIDUALS IN RECOVERY.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Generation Hope. Grant proceeds must be used for workforce innovation and job placement programs aimed at supporting individuals in recovery through:

(1) workforce training tailored to high-demand industries and emerging sectors;

(2) record expungement assistance to eliminate barriers to employment;

(3) workforce coaching to provide personalized career guidance, mentorship, and job placement services; and

(4) innovative strategies to connect participants to sustainable, long-term employment opportunities, including partnerships with local employers and community organizations.

This is a onetime appropriation.
